title: OpenXR: Support for `XR_MND_headless` extension

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
This PR's goal is to implement the [`XR_MND_headless` extension](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XR_MND_headless) (plus some other required ones) to allow usage of OpenXR's API without having to pass a graphics binding and thus being expected to render things to the HMD.

## Motivation

I'm co-maintaining and modding a FOSS 3D VTuber application called SnekStudio written in Godot. It can use webcam tracking or communicate with other apps (for example using the VMC protocol) to animate a 3D avatar with the user's movements and expressions. The app is then captured for example in OBS and overlaid over top of videos or live streams.

I wanted to make it possible for the app to hook into OpenXR to read the tracker information to drive the avatar's pose, but notably, without having to render anything to the HMD. This appears to be something that Godot currently doesn't support, but the `XR_MND_headless` extension should make this possible.

## Progress / checklist

- [x] Implement `XR_MND_headless`
- [ ] Implement `XR_KHR_convert_timespec_time` (unix)
- [ ] Implement `XR_KHR_win32_convert_performance_counter_time` (windows)
- [ ] Use converted time to populate `predictedDisplayTime` with a sensible value
- [ ] Ensure everything works with Monado and SteamVR while running a VR game simultaneously
- [ ] Extend `--xr-mode` to accept `headless` value as well
- [ ] Extend project settings to enable "headless" mode
- [ ] Documentation, release notes and all that?
- [ ] Clean up

## Why is this a draft?

Despite having gotten this far, I'm not at all familiar with C++, though working with Godot's codebase has been pretty straight-forward, so that's really nice.

I was able to do everything until I ran into the issue of some `#ifdef` blocks not evaluating, despite trying to define the symbol beforehand? This is where I need some help to get unblocked! I'm going to add some comments to the code where the issue occurs. Please take a look.

While getting the basics working and tested to see if it's even possible to move forward with this is the highest priority, I will also need some feedback to see if my approach is appropriate in regards to the CLI mode and project setting. (See checklist.)

I would also be fine with someone else more qualified taking over this task.

## Testing

Currently, the changes do not actually compile (see above), but I was able to compile, run and test the first commit, which skips registering a graphics binding entirely, only the tracking information was wildly incorrect.

I will update this section as I make progress and do further testing, though I might need someone to test the PR on a Windows machine. And potentially someone who can check if these extensions are supported with Meta's runtime, since it not working should probably be documented.
